paper_metadata.title: Cerebral blood flow in acute concussion: preliminary ASL findings from the NCAA-DoD CARE consortium

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study utilizes a well-defined sampling frame from a large-scale consortium (CARE). The inclusion of a matched contact control group from the same environment and the detailed description of baseline characteristics for both groups significantly limit selection bias.

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The primary outcome (CBF) was measured using two different ASL techniques (2D PASL vs 3D pCASL) across two different scanner vendors. While the authors adjusted for 'site' as a covariate, the inherent differences in measurement technology introduce a moderate risk of measurement bias.
